title: panel triad-verify leg — one refutation verdict
description: Output contract of one triad-verify panel leg: references/triad/prompts/refute.schema.json's verdict as the single entry of items. repro is required here (the empty string when refuted is true) because every field is required. The classifier assigns the item id <lab>-1.

items.description: Exactly one verdict on the one finding under test.

refuted.description: true kills the finding. Default to true when the defect could not be established — uncertainty is a refutation, not a survival.

ground.description: Which kill condition landed, or survived if none did.

basis.description: The receipt: the file:line read, the guard found and where it is, or the decision-log entry cited. Required for every verdict including refusals — 'seems unlikely' is not a basis.

repro.description: When refuted is false: the concrete input or sequence, and the wrong outcome. If this sentence cannot be written, the verdict is refuted. The empty string when refuted is true.
